snippet.title: Lochjaw for the Atari 2600
snippet.description:
This game was later released as Shark Attack. The name was changed due to a lawsuit over the name's similarity to the movie Jaws. There are some subtle differences between this game and Shark Attack. (Thanks Atarimania and AtariAge)

Nice Pac-Man rip-off, but it is hard to move through some "passages" sometimes.
